e03.prompt: Return only JSON with keys project, owner, due_date, status, evidence. Use only the memo. Copy each value exactly from its labeled line; evidence must contain those four keys with each entire exact source line. If a label is absent, use null for the value and evidence. Do not infer from notes.
e03.quality_floor: At least 9/10 accepted in each repetition for each provider; exact values and exact source lines; no fabricated evidence.

e04.adoption: No production adoption. Passing report requires explicit owner review of exact candidate.
